turns.message: FYI all, new keycard entry system goes live this weekend. Maintenance will swap out the front door lock Saturday morning. Your existing fob will still work for the elevator.
Oh good! The old lock has been sticking for months. Thanks for the update 👍
just a heads up everyone, my kids will probably buzz the door a dozen times before they figure out the card lol 😂 thanks Marcus!
lol solid. will the gym door get the new system too or just front?
Front entrance and laundry room for now. Gym and mail room in phase 2. – Marcus
For the record: the current lock has been broken for six weeks. Not ideal timing on the upgrade.
Yes!! Finally. You know what would make this even better? A coffee machine in the lobby for when you forget your card. Love this for the building 😄
fine by me. though I still say a regular key never needed a battery
noted! 👍
Copy that. Will the system work if the building loses power?
Yes, backup power for the entry system. Already tested. – Marcus
just a heads up everyone, also are we still doing the holiday decoration swap in the lobby? I have a box of winter stuff I can contribute 🎁
noted
yo anyone else excited to tap in like we're at a subway station lol 😄
When you're home all day you notice these things, the old key also rattled. Could be worse.
back when this place had a real key there was nothing to lose power. but fine.
Dan I get it! Change is hard. But trust me once you're in the building without fishing for keys you'll love it ☕
Marcus, yes that works for me. I will be home Saturday if they need access to anything.
Thanks Ruth, no access needed, it's just the front door hardware. sorted.
great! let us know if anything else, thanks Marcus 😊
FYI all, there was a package theft from the lobby yesterday afternoon. If you're expecting a delivery, pick it up as soon as you can. – Marcus
just a heads up everyone, oh no! which unit? can we set up an alert system or something? 😟
Not ideal. For the record: this is the third time in six months.
Ground floor near the mailboxes. We're looking at adding a camera. Will update. – Marcus
is it just me or should we do a sign-in sheet for packages? 👍
Would appreciate if people could text the group when they see a delivery for someone. Faster than waiting for pickup.
yo solid idea Sandra. also ngl I heard some people prop the front door open which prob doesn't help
I can keep an eye on deliveries from the cafe if they're near the entrance! Happy to store them if needed. Love this for the building 😊
fine by me on the camera. about time.
Amir that is so kind! 🙏 also totally different topic but, should we do a little building BBQ before it gets cold? like this Saturday? 🌭
love this idea! I'm free Saturday afternoon 👍
re: the package theft from last week, yes a camera is a good idea. Carmen, yes a BBQ sounds lovely.
Saturday works. Not opposed to free food.
I can come for a bit, I'm on nights that weekend but free in the afternoon. Sandra
YES!! BBQ!! We could do it in the courtyard. Or, idea, what if we do a cookout and everyone finishes at the cafe for dessert? Love that for us 🎉
omg Amir yes!! totally open to that! Marcus is that okay for the courtyard? 😊
Courtyard BBQ is fine, I'll unlock the gate. Bring your own chairs if you have them. – Marcus
I can bring a folding table.
sounds good 👍
Hi, I am locked out of the building. I think my keycard stopped working. I am outside now.
Coming down now. FYI this is a known issue with batch 2 cards, we're replacing them. – Marcus
just a heads up everyone, Yuki are you okay?? it's so cold out! 😟
Yuki! Come to the cafe door, I'll let you in from this side right now! Come around 😊
For the record: this is the third defective card reported this week. Not ideal.
Thank you, appreciated. Amir I am on my way.
Sorted. Yuki has a replacement card. Batch 2 fobs were defective, everyone from 4th floor, check your card works and DM me if not. – Marcus
thanks for the fast response everyone! is it just me or should we have a backup entry contact on the door? 👍
also Marcus, that package that went missing last month. police called me back. turns out the guy lives two blocks over. got it back.
oh my gosh Dan!! that is such a relief 😭🙏
Dan!! See, the group chat works! Love this for us 🎉 First round of coffee on me for everyone who helped Dan track it down!
Glad it worked out. The camera would still be a good idea.
lol Dan that's wild. solid outcome tho 🙌
yeah. useful thing, this chat.
Good news Dan. Copy that on the card issue, mine works fine, I'm on 3rd. Sandra
Thank you all. The fast response was very helpful. I appreciate it.
Marcus, yes I will check my card today. About the package, glad that worked out, Dan.
Yuki glad you got in ok! and Dan so glad it worked out 😊 this group is great 💕
Lobby camera is approved, installation next week. – Marcus
great news! noted 👍
just a heads up everyone, so I was thinking for the lobby we could put up some holiday decorations? I have tinsel, a wreath, little lights. would make it so cozy for everyone 🎄
oh I love this idea! I can bring some fairy lights 🌟 is it just me or does the lobby feel a bit bare?
YES!! holiday vibes in the lobby!! I will put a little tree in the cafe window too 🎉 love this for us!
lol festive 🎄 solid idea. I'm in
Fine by me. Not opposed.
No objections on my end. Just keep the fire exits clear. – Marcus
Carmen, yes a wreath would be nice. I have a small one I could contribute.
Ruth that's so sweet!! okay so we're doing it? I can set it up Friday evening 😊 also, Marcus you have been so reliable here, you know my old super was a nightmare. totally different experience.
Appreciate that Carmen. Though I'd say Elm Street wasn't that bad, mostly the boiler gave us trouble that winter. – Marcus
haha true! Marcus was the super at my old place on Elm Street too, guys, genuinely one of the best. so lucky he ended up here 😊
Good to know. Carmen, I'll be on shift Friday night but I can help set up earlier in the day if needed. Sandra
totally understand Sandra! totally fine, we'll get it done 💕
fine by me. just don't block the mailboxes.
ok
For the record: last year someone left lights plugged in all of January. A timer might be worth adding.
oh great call Felix!! I'll add a timer plug 👍
so smart. noted! 👍
Carmen let me know if you need an extra pair of hands Friday, I close at 5! Love this for us 🎄
yo also ngl I love the lobby vibes, good call everyone 🎄
Sorted on the decorations. Just keep the path to the fire exit clear. – Marcus
yo check this out lol 😂 [image: meme about apartment living]
haha 😂
what is this
Not building-related but noted.
lol Kevin 😄 also morning everyone! just a reminder the cafe is open from 7 for all your coffee needs ☕
just a heads up everyone, can we try to keep noise down in the evenings? especially after like 9-10pm. some of us work nights and need to sleep during the day 🙏
That's a good reminder, 10pm quiet hours are building policy. – Marcus
Would appreciate that. Thank you Carmen. Sandra
Noted. When you're home all day you notice this too, mid-afternoon can get loud near the stairwell.
totally agree on noise. noted! 👍
10pm is fine with me. I'm up at 5 anyway.
excuse me if I missed something, is this about the music from last week? I heard something near the elevator.
Ruth, just a general reminder. No specific incident. – Marcus
yeah my bad sometimes. I work late shifts so I lose track of time ngl
totally understand Kevin! just good to be mindful 😊
Thank you. The quiet hours help me work.
noted! also if anyone ever needs to decompress the cafe is open till 9 most nights, very quiet in the evenings 😊
copy that on the stairwell Felix, I'll mention it to the unit there. Sandra
oh also is it just me or is the laundry room light flickering? might need a bulb 👍
Thanks Priya, I'll check it. – Marcus
For the record: a coffee machine in the lobby would not be the worst idea. When you're home all day, the walk to a cafe adds up.
I make my own at home. but fine.
Felix!! I love you but please come to my cafe 😄 first round always on me for building residents!
The issue is not the quality, Amir. It is the distance relative to pajamas.
haha Felix I completely relate. would love a coffee spot downstairs! is it just me or would everyone use that? ☕👍
yo ngl that would be clutch lol
just a heads up everyone, this is a great idea! I'd use it every morning with the kids on the way to school 🙌
Okay okay. Hear me out. What if I put a small coffee station just inside the building entrance? Like a Little Free Coffee Library but for espresso 😄 love this for us!
Worth exploring Amir. Would need to discuss the lease terms. – Marcus
re: the lobby machine from a few messages ago, that sounds convenient. I often forget my coffee upstairs.
Would use it before my night shifts. Good idea. Sandra
Thank you, that would be helpful.
Not opposed to Amir's version. Though I note the logistics are non-trivial.
Marcus please make this happen! would make mornings so much better 😊👍
lol Amir you're really out here running a whole coffee empire from the ground floor
that's the dream Kevin 😄 love this for us! Marcus let's talk!
as long as it doesn't block the mailboxes. fine by me.
omg this building is the best 😭💕 also reminder, building BBQ rescheduled from last month, should we pick a new date?
Good point Carmen. Let me check the courtyard calendar. – Marcus
For the record: still available on weekends.
FYI all, courtyard is free the weekend of Feb 15-16. BBQ take 2? – Marcus
just a heads up everyone, YES!! Feb 15 Saturday works great for me and the little ones 🎉
perfect timing! I'll be back from my sister's by then. see you at 7am Sandra btw, yoga is back on after last week's sub 🧘
Copy that. See you there. Sandra
yo Feb 15 solid! I'll actually be free that one for real lol
Available. Not opposed to a BBQ.
Carmen, yes February 15 works for me.
fine by me. I'll bring the folding table again.
Dan you are the MVP 🙏 also, should we do a small indoor drinks beforehand in the common room? like a little pre-BBQ gathering?
Love the BBQ idea!! For the pre-gathering, what if we just meet at the cafe instead? I can do little snacks, easy setup, and then we walk over to the courtyard together 😄
oh that's fun! Amir's cafe sounds nice 👍
Practical. The common room needs to be booked in advance anyway.
Common room would need 48h notice to unlock. Amir's suggestion is simpler. – Marcus
totally makes sense! okay so cafe first then courtyard, love it 💕
Thank you. I will try to come.
yo solid. Amir is basically our unofficial social chair lol 😄
I'll take that title Kevin!! Love this for us. First espresso free for everyone who shows 🎉☕
I'll be there. Table is already in the car.
I'll come if I'm off shift, working to confirm. Sandra
excuse me if I missed something, is the BBQ this Saturday? I want to make sure I have the right date.
just a heads up everyone, that BBQ was SO lovely!! thank you all 😭💕 Dan your folding table was perfect, Amir the espressos were incredible 🙌
LOVED IT!! Best building event we've ever done. Same time next month? Love this for us 🎉☕
lol yo that was actually really fun. ngl I didn't expect to enjoy hanging with my neighbors this much 😄
good afternoon. I had a good time. thanks for organizing.
that was so fun!! is it just me or should we make this a monthly thing? 👍
Not opposed. The organization was competent this time. That's high praise from me.
I really enjoyed it. Thank you everyone for organizing. Could we do another in March?
Good event. Thanks Carmen. Sandra
yes it was a lovely afternoon. thank you Carmen and Amir.
Good feedback all around. FYI, lobby camera is now active. Footage stored for 30 days. – Marcus
For the record: finally. Only took four months. Could be worse.
yay! such a relief 😊 also Marcus I keep meaning to say, you run such a tight ship here. way better than our old place 😂
Appreciate it Carmen. Elm Street's boiler made everything harder. Easier here. – Marcus
Marcus, the front entry light on the ground floor is out. just noticed.
Thanks Dan, sorted by tomorrow. – Marcus
yo also ngl the building feels way more chill lately. like I actually know people now lol
That's what I'm saying Kevin!! Community!! Love this for us ☕🎉 also cafe is open late tonight if anyone wants to celebrate good vibes
noted!! might stop by after work 👍
Amir I will come by this evening if that works.
I'll stop in for a coffee Amir. see you later.
